lines.beaver_en: Welcome. Do you have a prescription?
lines.learner: 네, 아까 내과에서 받았는데요. 여기 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, I got it at internal medicine earlier. Here it is.
lines.roman: ne, akka naegwaeseo badanneundeyo. yeogi isseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: It's cold medicine. Where does it hurt?
lines.en: My throat hurts, and I have a slight fever too.

lines.beaver: 그럼 이 약을 하루 세 번 드세요.
lines.beaver_en: Then take this medicine three times a day.
lines.beaver_roman: geureom i yageul haru se beon deuseyo.
lines.learner: 밥을 안 먹었는데 약을 먹어도 돼요?
lines.en: I haven't eaten. Can I take the medicine?
lines.roman: babeul an meogeonneunde yageul meogeodo dwaeyo?

lines.beaver_en: No, be sure to take it after a meal.
lines.en: Okay. Is the rest of the medicine cold medicine too?

lines.beaver: 이건 목에 뿌리는 약이에요. 이렇게 누르세요.
lines.beaver_en: This is a throat spray. Press it like this.
lines.beaver_roman: igeon moge ppurineun yagieyo. ireoke nureuseyo.
lines.en: I've never seen medicine like this, but it looks convenient.

lines.beaver_en: Are you all done at the hospital today?
lines.learner: 제 치료는 끝났는데 오후에 병문안을 가요.
lines.en: My treatment is done, but I'm visiting a sick friend this afternoon.
lines.roman: je chiryoneun kkeunnanneunde ohue byeongmunaneul gayo.

lines.beaver_en: Oh, a hospital visit? Which hospital?
lines.en: My friend hurt his leg, and he's at Hanguk Hospital.

lines.beaver: 아, 한국병원이요? 거기는 면회 시간이 있어요.
lines.beaver_en: Oh, Hanguk Hospital? They have visiting hours.
lines.beaver_roman: a, hangukbyeongwoniyo? geogineun myeonhoe sigani isseoyo.
lines.en: Really? I don't know the times, though.

lines.beaver_en: Ask a nurse about the times.
lines.learner: 네, 물어볼게요. 친구한테 약도 사 갈까요?
lines.en: Okay, I will. Should I buy medicine for my friend too?
lines.roman: ne, mureobolgeyo. chinguhante yakdo sa galkkayo?

lines.beaver: 친구 약은 병원에서 줄 거예요. 과일이 좋아요.
lines.beaver_en: The hospital will give him medicine. Fruit is better.
lines.beaver_roman: chingu yageun byeongwoneseo jul geoyeyo. gwairi joayo.
